speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever after recently taking antibiotics for sinusitis. Can you describe the severity of the flank pain and whether you've noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain or burning sensation when you urinate, and have you noticed any nausea or vomiting accompanying these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the rash appear again after switching to cephalexin, and are you currently experiencing any shortness of breath or swelling in your face or extremities? I need to rule out a severe allergic reaction like serum sickness or acute interstitial nephritis.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text:
